title: SSP Scholarship 2026-27 Applications Open — Fees Only ₹50!
author: Hafiz Ramajan
summary: Karnataka SSP scholarship forms 1st to 10th, PUC & Degree students ke liye online shuru ho chuke hain. Sirf ₹50 me online form bharein.
content: Karnataka Government SSP Scholarship forms are actively being processed at Excellence Services, Raibag. Students must bring Aadhaar Card, Fee Receipt, Bank Passbook, and Previous Year Marks Card. Our service fee is only ₹50. Visit our shop near Iqra School, Raibag.

title: New Color PVC Digital Voter ID Card Service Started
author: Hafiz Ramajan
summary: Apne purane black & white Voter ID card ko naye high quality color PVC plastic card me convert karwayen.
content: Election Commission of India ke naye format me digital color Voter ID cards print ho rahe hain. Agar aapke voter card me purani photo ya galat spelling hai, to use bhi update karwaya ja sakta hai. Excellence Services me same-day service uplabdh hai.

title: Passport Seva Kendra: Name Spelling Discrepancy Policy
author: Hafiz Ramajan
summary: Aadhaar Card aur 10th Marksheet me 1 letter ka bhi spelling farak hone par Annexure-D affidavit zaroori hai. Full checkup available.
content: Passport application reject hone se bachne ke liye biometric appointment se pehle documents cross-verify karwayen. Agar Aadhaar aur 10th Marksheet me naam alag hai to Annexure-D One & Same Person affidavit lagana lazmi hota hai. Hum pura document set tayyar karke dete hain.

title: Instant e-PAN Card & Aadhaar-PAN Biometric Linking
author: Hafiz Ramajan
summary: Naya instant PAN card sirf 2 ghante me banwayen aur Aadhaar-PAN biometric correction karwayen.
content: Income Tax Department portal par naya PAN Card file karne aur biometric update karne ki service Excellence Services par uplabdh hai. Physical PVC card aapke ghar direct dispatch hoga.

title: Police Verification Certificate (PCC) Online Application
author: Hafiz Ramajan
summary: Gulf visa aur international jobs ke liye Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) fast processing uplabdh hai.
content: PSK aur police station se Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) ke liye appointment aur online application service Excellence Services par uplabdh hai.

title: Karnataka Ration Card BPL/APL Name Addition & Split
author: Hafiz Ramajan
summary: Ahara portal par naye bachhon ka naam jodne aur parivar split form online submit ho rahe hain.
content: Karnataka Ahara portal par Ration card me naye sadasya jodne, biometric e-KYC karne aur card download karne ki service shuru hai.
